## Overview Add native support for [inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny). vLLM-Omni will be updated to use cls/func from upstream vLLM (after next release) to support models incorporating Ming-3-asr as a component (e.g., `inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-audio-flash`) ## Claims - Support native `inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny` model - Online serving, offline inference - Transcription of multiple languages and dialects; features such as full-history no-repeat n-gram blocking - Benchmarking and validating ## Validation 1. Unit tests added or modified; related ut cmds: ```bash pytest -s \ tests/models/multimodal/processing/test_ming_v3_asr.py \ tests/models/multimodal/processing/test_bailing_moe_v3_vl.py \ tests/models/test_ming_v3_asr_logits_processor.py \ tests/entrypoints/speech_to_text/transcription/test_qwen3_asr_sanitize_prompt.py \ tests/entrypoints/speech_to_text/transcription/test_transcription_inter_chunk_spacing.py -q VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error python -m pytest \ tests/entrypoints/speech_to_text/transcription/test_ming_v3_asr.py -q ``` 2. offline inference example ```bash CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 \ python examples/speech_to_text/ming_v3_asr.py \ --model /path/to/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny \ --audio /path/to/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr/examples/cases/audio/english_common_voice.wav \ --language en ``` out: `same way you did` 3. online serving Launch server: ```bash vllm serve inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny --trust-remote-code # Each condition used a full warmup followed by one timed pass over SeedTTS prompt audio (1,088 English and 2,020 Chinese clips) *For this one, used Seed-TTS ref recordings (`prompt-wavs/`) and prompt transcripts, with Whisper English normalization. Different from `wavs/` used in the next table. Accuracy (for other benchmarks) | Dataset / Metric | #Items | vLLM | Model Vendor | Err / Refs | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | Seed-TTS target EN WER | 1,088 | 2.659890% | - | 314 / 11,805 | | Seed-TTS target ZH CER | 2,020 | 0.889604% | - | 376 / 42,266 | | AISHELL-1 CER | 7,176 | 1.049969% | 1.07% | 1,100 / 104,765 | | LibriSpeech clean WER | 2,620 | 1.197503% | 1.29% | 635 / 53,027 | | LibriSpeech other WER | 2,939 | 2.397791% | 2.56% | 1,268 / 52,882 | *For Seed-TTS, used Seed-TTS target recordings (`wavs/`) and target transcripts, scored with the vendor’s general normalization rules to track accuracy across implementation changes. *Accuracy Reference from official model vendor: https://github.com/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr/blob/6141e8c552815db724d8df0f72c9d865c547a1ea/figures/open-asr.png ## Details ASR model should be supported in vLLM rather than vLLM-Omni, while vLLM-Omni could use an ASR model from upstream vLLM as a component in another model (I'll update in vLLM-Omni after next releasing). +guide: |
+  ## Overview
+
+  [Ming-3.0-asr-tiny](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny) supports Chinese, English, and dialect transcription with optional topic, hotword, and dialogue context. 
+  This guide covers single-GPU serving, transcription, streaming, Context ASR, and offline inference with vLLM.
+
+  ## Public example audio
+
+  Download the three clips from the official inference repository:
+
+  ```bash
+  MING_AUDIO_BASE=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr/6141e8c552815db724d8df0f72c9d865c547a1ea/examples/cases/audio
+  curl -fL "$MING_AUDIO_BASE/english_common_voice.wav" -o english.wav
+  curl -fL "$MING_AUDIO_BASE/chinese_common_voice.wav" -o chinese.wav
+  curl -fL "$MING_AUDIO_BASE/context_same_sentence_pcm16.wav" -o context.wav
+  ```
+
+  | Clip | Observed transcription |
+  | --- | --- |
+  | English | `same way you did` |
+  | Mandarin | `漓江和湘江有秦代开凿的灵渠沟通` |
+  | Context clip with the hints below | Contains the film title `同囚` |
+
+  The Context clip illustrates correction of `铜球` to `同囚` with a relevant topic and hotwords. These are sample-specific observations, not a general Context ASR accuracy claim. Audio provenance and licenses are documented in the [official examples](https://github.com/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr/blob/6141e8c552815db724d8df0f72c9d865c547a1ea/examples/cases/README.md).
+
+  For accuracy comparisons, keep batch settings and attention backends consistent; greedy transcription outputs can differ across these configurations.
+
+  ## Transcription API
+
+  Use the audio requests below to verify speech recognition. The catalog's generic text-only cURL and benchmark shortcuts do not exercise ASR.
+
+  ```bash
+  curl http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions \
+    -F model=inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny \
+    -F file=@chinese.wav \
+    -F temperature=0 \
+    -F max_completion_tokens=256 \
+    -F 'vllm_xargs={"no_repeat_ngram_size":10}'
+  ```
+
+  Omit `language` for automatic recognition, or use `language=zh` / `language=en` to seed the known language. These are the supported language-hint codes; dialect transcription does not introduce additional hint codes. The response contains the transcript without the generated language label. `response_format=json` and `response_format=text` are supported.
+
+  ### OpenAI Python client
+
+  ```python
+  import json
+  from openai import OpenAI
+
+  client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:8000/v1", api_key="EMPTY")
+  with open("english.wav", "rb") as audio:
+      result = client.audio.transcriptions.create(
+          model="inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny",
+          file=audio,
+          temperature=0,
+          extra_body={
+              "max_completion_tokens": 256,
+              "vllm_xargs": json.dumps({"no_repeat_ngram_size": 10}),
+          },
+      )
+  print(result.text)
+  ```
+
+  `vllm_xargs` is JSON-encoded for the multipart request, as in the cURL examples.
+
+  ### Context ASR
+
+  ```bash
+  curl http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions \
+    -F model=inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny \
+    -F file=@context.wav \
+    -F language=zh \
+    -F temperature=0 \
+    -F max_completion_tokens=256 \
+    -F 'prompt=This is an audio about 同囚.' \
+    -F 'hotwords=同囚,黄国权,游学修,关楚耀,赵永洪,赵咏瑶,狱警,长镜头,吞玻璃戏,糖化玻璃,真实案例数据.' \
+    -F 'vllm_xargs={"no_repeat_ngram_size":10,"context_chunks":true}'
+  ```
+
+  `prompt` accepts topic or preceding dialogue appended to the official ASR instruction, or the full official instruction followed by context. Context and hotwords must be single-line text without audio placeholders. To reproduce the vendor's full prompt exactly, put its hotword text in `prompt` and omit the separate `hotwords` field.
+
+  ### Streaming
+
+  ```bash
+  curl -N http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions \
+    -F model=inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny \
+    -F file=@english.wav \
+    -F language=en \
+    -F temperature=0 \
+    -F stream=true \
+    -F max_completion_tokens=256 \
+    -F 'vllm_xargs={"no_repeat_ngram_size":10}'
+  ```
+
+  Streaming sends transcript deltas after the complete audio upload. It is not live microphone input. The English clip produces `same way you did` without leaking the language prefix into the transcript.
+
+  ## Chunking and repetition control
+
+  Audio is downmixed and resampled to 16 kHz using torchaudio. The processor extracts the entire clip's log-mel features before splitting encoder chunks. Chunk settings are request-local and are included in multimodal cache keys.
+
+  | Option in `vllm_xargs` | Behavior |
+  | --- | --- |
+  | No chunk option | Use 3,000-mel-frame encoder chunks, approximately 30 seconds each. |
+  | `"context_chunks": true` | Use 3,000 frames up to 30 seconds and 6,000 frames for 30–60 seconds; reject longer clips. |
+  | `"audio_chunk_frames": 6000` | Explicit chunk size; any integer from 1 through 6,000 is accepted. |
+  | `"no_repeat_ngram_size": 10` | Block repeated 10-grams over prompt plus generated tokens. |
+
+  `context_chunks` and an explicit `audio_chunk_frames` are mutually exclusive. Ordinary chunking can handle clips beyond 60 seconds within the shared 8,192-token input/output budget and audio-upload size limit. Internal encoder chunking does not create separate transcription requests.
+
+  The no-repeat feature loads a plugin; each request must still set a nonzero `no_repeat_ngram_size` to enable blocking. Omitted values and `0` leave ordinary sampling in effect. Blocking uses the full prompt/output history, and requires Model Runner V2. Speculative decoding and MTP are unsupported with this plugin.
+
+  ## Offline inference
+
+  From the same vLLM source checkout, use the shared [audio language model example](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/examples/generate/multimodal/audio_language_offline.py) with its built-in audio assets:
+
+  ```bash
+  python examples/generate/multimodal/audio_language_offline.py --model-type ming_v3_asr
+  ```
+
+  This uses the shared example's sampling defaults (`temperature=0.2`, `max_tokens=64`) and prints raw model output, including the language label. For the downloaded Context clip, use the native prompt builder with greedy decoding and 10-gram blocking:
+
+  ```python
+  from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
+  from vllm.config.speech_to_text import SpeechToTextParams
+  from vllm.model_executor.models.ming_v3_asr import (
+      MingV3ASRForConditionalGeneration as MingASR,
+  )
+  from vllm.multimodal.audio import AudioResampler
+  from vllm.multimodal.media.audio import load_audio
+
+  def main():
+      llm = LLM(
+          model="inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny",
+          trust_remote_code=True,
+          dtype="bfloat16",
+          max_model_len=8192,
+          max_num_seqs=4,
+          enforce_eager=True,
+          logits_processors=[
+              "vllm.model_executor.models.ming_v3_asr_logits_processor:"
+              "NoRepeatNGramLogitsProcessor",
+          ],
+      )
+      audio, rate = load_audio("context.wav", sr=None, mono=True)
+      audio = AudioResampler(16000).resample(audio, orig_sr=rate)
+      params = SpeechToTextParams(
+          audio=audio,
+          stt_config=MingASR.get_speech_to_text_config(llm.model_config, "transcribe"),
+          model_config=llm.model_config,
+          language="zh",
+          request_prompt="This is an audio about 同囚.",
+          hotwords=(
+              "同囚,黄国权,游学修,关楚耀,赵永洪,赵咏瑶,狱警,长镜头,"
+              "吞玻璃戏,糖化玻璃,真实案例数据."
+          ),
+          extra_args={"context_chunks": True},
+      )
+      outputs = llm.generate(
+          MingASR.get_generation_prompt(params),
+          SamplingParams(
+              temperature=0,
+              max_tokens=256,
+              extra_args={"no_repeat_ngram_size": 10},
+          ),
+      )
+      print(MingASR.post_process_output(outputs[0].outputs[0].text))
+
+
+  if __name__ == "__main__":
+      main()
+  ```
+
+  ## Limitations
+
+  The [official model card](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny#usage-notes) describes transcription text output without word-level timestamps or speaker diarization.
+
+  The current vLLM integration does not support translation, segment timestamps, or live audio input. Translation and timestamp requests are rejected. The `context_chunks=true` policy accepts clips up to 60 seconds; ordinary chunking, including requests with context prompts, can accept longer clips subject to the model context and upload limits. Longer recordings can produce incomplete transcripts; accepting an upload does not guarantee complete transcription.

+    kernels = config.downsampler_kernel_size_list
+    strides = config.downsampler_stride_list
+    paddings = config.downsampler_padding_list
+    if not kernels or not (len(kernels) == len(strides) == len(paddings)):
+        raise ValueError("Audio convolution lists must have equal positive length")
+    params = list(zip(kernels, strides, paddings))
+    if any(
+        kernel <= 0 or stride <= 0 or padding < 0 for kernel, stride, padding in params
+    ):

+        )
+    return params

+def get_audio_token_count(
+    config: MingAudioConfig, num_frames: int, chunk_frames: int
+) -> int:
+    """Count projected frames with independent encoder positions for each chunk."""
+    if num_frames <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("Audio must contain at least one mel frame")
+    params = _get_audio_projector_params(config)
+
+    def output_length(length: int) -> int:
+        length = (length + 1) // 2
+        for kernel, stride, padding in params:
+            length = (length + 2 * padding - kernel) // stride + 1
+        if length <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Audio chunk is too short for its projector")
+        return length

+    num_chunks, tail = divmod(num_frames, chunk_frames)

+class MingASRDummyInputsBuilder(BaseDummyInputsBuilder[MingASRProcessingInfo]):
+    def get_dummy_text(self, mm_counts: Mapping[str, int]) -> str:

+        self,
+        seq_len: int,
+        mm_counts: Mapping[str, int],
+        mm_options: MultiModalDummyOptions,

+        audio_options = self.info.get_audio_options({})
+        config = self.info.get_hf_config().audio_config
+        chunk_frames = _get_audio_chunk_frames(config, audio_options, 60 * 16000)
+        budget = self.info.get_mm_max_tokens_per_item(seq_len, mm_counts)["audio"]
+        low, high = 1, budget * 4 + chunk_frames
+        if audio_options.get("context_chunks"):
+            high = min(high, 6000)
+        while low < high:
+            middle = (low + high + 1) // 2
+            if get_audio_token_count(config, middle, chunk_frames) <= budget:
+                low = middle
+            else:
+                high = middle - 1
+        return {

+class MingASRMultiModalProcessor(BaseMultiModalProcessor[MingASRProcessingInfo]):
+    def _call_hf_processor(
+        self, hf_data: Mapping[str, object], hf_kwargs: Mapping[str, object]
+    ) -> BatchFeature:
+        config = self.info.get_hf_config().audio_config
+        feature_extractor = self.info.get_feature_extractor()
+        audio_options = self.info.get_audio_options(hf_kwargs)
+        features, lengths, chunk_frames = [], [], []
+        audios = hf_data.get("audio", [])
+        assert isinstance(audios, list)
+        for audio in audios:
+            frames = _get_audio_chunk_frames(config, audio_options, len(audio))
+            waveform = torch.as_tensor(audio)
+            if waveform.ndim != 1 or waveform.numel() <= 200:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Ming audio requires more than 200 mono samples at 16 kHz"
+                )
+            if waveform.is_complex() or not torch.isfinite(waveform).all():
+                raise ValueError("Audio must contain finite real samples")
+            inputs = feature_extractor(
+                waveform.detach().to(device="cpu", dtype=torch.float32).numpy(),
+                sampling_rate=feature_extractor.sampling_rate,
+                padding=False,
+                truncation=False,
+                return_tensors="pt",
+            )
+            feature = inputs.input_features[0].T.to(torch.bfloat16)
+            features.append(feature)
+            lengths.append(len(feature))
+            chunk_frames.append(frames)
+        return BatchFeature(
+            {
+                "audio_feats": features,
+                "audio_feats_lengths": torch.tensor(lengths),
+                "audio_chunk_frames": torch.tensor(chunk_frames),
+            }
+        )
+
+    def _get_mm_fields_config(
+        self,
+        hf_inputs: BatchFeature,
+        hf_processor_mm_kwargs: Mapping[str, object],
+    ) -> Mapping[str, MultiModalFieldConfig]:
+        return {
+            name: MultiModalFieldConfig.batched(
+                "audio", keep_on_cpu=name != "audio_feats"
+            )
+            for name in ("audio_feats", "audio_feats_lengths", "audio_chunk_frames")
+        }
+
+    def _get_prompt_updates(
+        self,
+        mm_items: MultiModalDataItems,
+        hf_processor_mm_kwargs: Mapping[str, object],
+        out_mm_kwargs: MultiModalKwargsItems,
+    ) -> Sequence[PromptReplacement]:
+        config = self.info.get_hf_config()
+        data = out_mm_kwargs.get_data()
+        lengths = torch.as_tensor(data.get("audio_feats_lengths", [])).flatten()
+        frames = torch.as_tensor(data.get("audio_chunk_frames", [])).flatten()
+        counts = [
+            get_audio_token_count(config.audio_config, int(length), int(chunk))
+            for length, chunk in zip(lengths, frames, strict=True)
+        ]
+        return [
+            PromptReplacement(
+                modality="audio",
+                target=[config.audio_token_id],
+                replacement=lambda index: [config.audio_token_id] * counts[index],
+            )
+        ]
+

+"""Opt-in full-history n-gram blocking for Ming ASR on Model Runner V2."""
+
+from numbers import Integral
+
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.logits_processor.interface import LogitsProcessor
+
+
+class NoRepeatNGramLogitsProcessor(LogitsProcessor):
+    @classmethod
+    def validate_params(cls, sampling_params):
+        size = (sampling_params.extra_args or {}).get("no_repeat_ngram_size", 0)
+        if (
+            isinstance(size, bool)
+            or not isinstance(size, Integral)
+            or not 0 <= int(size) < 2**31
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("no_repeat_ngram_size must be an integer in [0, 2**31)")
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, req_states):
+        import torch
+
+        from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.buffer_utils import UvaBackedTensor
+
+        if vllm_config.speculative_config is not None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "NoRepeatNGramLogitsProcessor does not support speculation"
+            )
+        self.req_states = req_states
+        self.sizes = UvaBackedTensor(req_states.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32)
+
+    def add_request(self, req_idx, sampling_params):
+        self.validate_params(sampling_params)
+        self.sizes.np[req_idx] = int(
+            (sampling_params.extra_args or {}).get("no_repeat_ngram_size", 0)
+        )
+        return bool(self.sizes.np[req_idx] > 0)
+
+    def apply_staged_writes(self):
+        self.sizes.copy_to_uva()
+
+    def apply(self, logits, ctx):
+        import torch
+
+        sizes = set(self.sizes.np[ctx.idx_mapping_np].tolist())
+        if sizes == {0}:
+            return logits
+        slots = ctx.expanded_idx_mapping.long()
+        history = self.req_states.all_token_ids.gpu.index_select(0, slots)
+        lengths = ctx.pos + 1
+        for size in sizes:
+            if size == 0 or size > history.shape[1]:
+                continue
+            windows = history.unfold(1, size, 1)
+            valid = (
+                torch.arange(windows.shape[1], device=logits.device)[None, :]
+                <= lengths[:, None] - size
+            )
+            valid &= self.sizes.gpu[slots, None] == size
+            if size > 1:
+                positions = (
+                    lengths[:, None]
+                    - size
+                    + 1
+                    + torch.arange(size - 1, device=logits.device)[None, :]
+                )
+                prefix = history.gather(1, positions.clamp(min=0).long())
+                valid &= (windows[:, :, :-1] == prefix[:, None, :]).all(dim=2)
+            token_ids = windows[:, :, -1].long()
+            # Input embeddings may have a larger vocabulary than output logits.
+            valid &= (token_ids >= 0) & (token_ids < logits.shape[1])
+            penalties = torch.where(valid, -float("inf"), 0.0)
+            logits.scatter_add_(1, token_ids.clamp(0, logits.shape[1] - 1), penalties)
+
+        return logits

+"""Whisper feature extraction with Ming's mel coefficient precision."""
+
+import numpy as np
+from transformers import WhisperFeatureExtractor
+from transformers.audio_utils import hertz_to_mel, mel_filter_bank, mel_to_hertz
+
+
+class MingASRFeatureExtractor(WhisperFeatureExtractor):
+    def __init__(self, feature_size: int = 128) -> None:
+        if feature_size not in (80, 128):
+            raise ValueError("Ming audio requires 80 or 128 mel bins")
+        super().__init__(feature_size=feature_size)
+        max_frequency = self.sampling_rate / 2
+        filters = mel_filter_bank(
+            num_frequency_bins=1 + self.n_fft // 2,
+            num_mel_filters=feature_size,
+            min_frequency=0.0,
+            max_frequency=max_frequency,
+            sampling_rate=self.sampling_rate,
+            norm=None,
+            mel_scale="slaney",
+        )
+        centers = mel_to_hertz(
